import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision import transforms
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import timm
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set device
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Paths (verified via data overview)
train_dir = "input/train"
test_dir = "input/test"
train_csv = "input/train.csv"
sample_sub = "input/sample_submission.csv"
submission_path = "submission/submission.csv"

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_csv)
test_df = pd.read_csv(sample_sub)

# Stratified train/validation split (fixed seed, 20% hold-out)
train_indices, val_indices = train_test_split(
    train_df.index, test_size=0.2, stratify=train_df["has_cactus"], random_state=42
)


# Custom dataset
class CactusDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, return_id=False):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.return_id = return_id

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["id"])
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        if self.transform is not None:
            image = self.transform(image)
        if "has_cactus" in row:
            label = row["has_cactus"]
            if self.return_id:
                return image, torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32), row["id"]
            return image, torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32)
        else:
            if self.return_id:
                return image, row["id"]
            return image


# Train/val transforms
train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(p=0.2),
        transforms.RandomRotation(15),
        transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.3, contrast=0.3, saturation=0.3, hue=0.1),
        transforms.RandomAffine(degrees=0, translate=(0.1, 0.1), scale=(0.9, 1.1)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

val_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

# TTA transforms
tta_transforms = [
    transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    ),
    transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=1.0),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    ),
    transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(p=1.0),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    ),
]

# Datasets and loaders
train_dataset = CactusDataset(
    train_df.loc[train_indices].copy(), train_dir, transform=train_transform
)
val_dataset = CactusDataset(
    train_df.loc[val_indices].copy(), train_dir, transform=val_transform
)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=64, shuffle=True, num_workers=0)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=64, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)


# Model
class CactusModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            "efficientnet_b0", pretrained=True, in_chans=3
        )
        self.backbone.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(self.backbone.classifier.in_features, 1)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.backbone(x)


model = CactusModel().to(device)

# Training
criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
best_auc, best_epoch, patience, num_epochs = 0.0, 0, 3, 10

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0.0
    for images, labels in train_loader:
        images, labels = images.to(device), labels.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(images).squeeze()
        loss = criterion(outputs, labels)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item()
    train_loss /= len(train_loader)

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_labels = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, labels in val_loader:
            images = images.to(device)
            outputs = model(images).squeeze()
            val_preds.extend(torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu().numpy())
            val_labels.extend(labels.cpu().numpy())
    val_auc = roc_auc_score(val_labels, val_preds)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} - Loss: {train_loss:.4f} - Val AUC: {val_auc:.4f}"
    )

    if val_auc > best_auc:
        best_auc = val_auc
        best_epoch = epoch
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pt")
    if epoch - best_epoch >= patience:
        print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
        break

# Load best model
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pt"))


# TTA for test set
class TTADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transforms_list):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transforms_list = transforms_list

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["id"])
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        aug_images = [t(image) for t in self.transforms_list]
        return torch.stack(aug_images), row["id"]


tta_dataset = TTADataset(test_df, test_dir, tta_transforms)
tta_loader = DataLoader(tta_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)

model.eval()
all_tta_preds = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for images_batch, ids in tta_loader:
        b, t, c, h, w = images_batch.shape
        images_flat = images_batch.view(-1, c, h, w).to(device)
        outputs_flat = model(images_flat).squeeze(-1)
        tta_outputs = outputs_flat.view(b, t).mean(dim=1)
        all_tta_preds.extend(torch.sigmoid(tta_outputs).cpu().numpy())

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"id": test_df["id"].values, "has_cactus": np.array(all_tta_preds).astype(float)}
)
submission.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

print(f"\nFinal validation AUC-ROC (hold-out): {best_auc:.4f}")
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
